title: M3.0 Authoring Foundation contradictory QA
purpose: Prepare and execute an independent contradictory oracle for M3.0 Authoring Foundation without repairing product implementation, then bind final QA to one exact frozen ATLAS-WP-009 HEAD.
invariants: QA is independent and never repairs or authors ATLAS-WP-009 product files.
The oracle may be prepared from the common baseline but final PASS requires exact frozen product-head binding.
QA delta from the final product HEAD is exactly the three QA-owned paths.
Canonical schema, validators and proof kits remain read-only.
No-op export byte identity is required, not approximate semantic equivalence.
Lineage/revision/digest/claim rules are checked independently from product developer examples.
Authoring storage isolation and loopback/no-network boundaries are adversarially tested.
Any scope, determinism, validator-authority or learner-runtime divergence yields HOLD.
requiredEvidence: Independent no-op byte-identity checks for both canonical proof kits.
Independent QCM and fill edit cases with lineage preservation and required revision rotation.
Independent stale-digest and stale-claim rejection cases.
Independent duplicate-key, malformed-UTF8, phase/role, QCM and fill corruption cases.
Export is impossible when canonical validation fails.
Loopback binding, no permissive CORS and no outbound network are proven.
Exported edited kits pass canonical validators and real Learn-it import regression.
Product source paths outside the accepted M3.0 allowlist remain unchanged.
Final QA records exact product HEAD and evidence digest before PASS.
adversarialTests: Developer-only happy paths that miss stale revision identity.
Fake green UI while canonical validators reject.
Claim/digest recomputation omitted after visible stimulus edits.
Preview divergence treated as runtime proof.
Product/QA path overlap or QA repair.
Final PASS attempted without exact-head binding.
independentReview: QA oracle is authored independently from ATLAS-WP-009 tests.
Final QA uses the exact product HEAD as its base/binding and verifies only QA-owned delta.
Repository governance and PR scope validate the QA branch.
Human authoring gate is separate and occurs only after QA PASS.
rollback: Drop the QA branch/PR only. No product file is changed or repaired by this package.
